units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 24. Officials entrusted with presenting awards are responsible for their timely and proper presentation. 25. Awards are presented in a solemn and public setting at events specially organised for that purpose. The relevant certificates or diplomas are issued at the same time.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “24. Officials entrusted with presenting awards are responsible…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 26. Awards and their documents whose presentation is entrusted to heads of territorial, sectoral and functional executive authorities are collected from the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow by staff of those authorities’ personnel units under a power of attorney.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “26. Awards and their documents whose presentation is entrusted…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 27. Awards and documents received by personnel units for presentation to recipients are entered in register books (cards) in accordance with the established procedure for accounting for material assets.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “27. Awards and documents received by personnel units for…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: Storage arrangements for awards and their documents must ensure full protection against theft, fire and damage. Awards and their documents are kept in safes or metal cabinets in rooms inaccessible to unauthorised persons.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “Storage arrangements for awards and their documents must ensure…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: By an administrative order (executive order) of the head of the organisation, custody of awards and their documents is entrusted to a designated employee who bears financial liability for their safekeeping <*>.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “By an administrative order (executive order) of the head of the…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 28. Forms of the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow and certificates for awards are completed neatly and legibly in black drawing ink or using a personal computer; no corrections are permitted.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “28. Forms of the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow and…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: The Mayor’s signature on award certificates and the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow is authenticated with the official coat-of-arms seal ‘Mayor of Moscow’.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “The Mayor’s signature on award certificates and the…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 29. Blank award documents spoiled during completion or otherwise damaged are returned to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “29. Blank award documents spoiled during completion or…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 30. Award certificates have no expiry date and are not replaced when the recipient changes surname, first name or patronymic.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “30. Award certificates have no expiry date and are not replaced…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 31. A record of the presentation of awards is drawn up and carefully checked against the award legal act (or extract). Corrections and erasures in the records are not permitted.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “31. A record of the presentation of awards is drawn up and…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: The record is signed by the person who presented the awards and affixed with an official coat-of-arms seal. A copy is made and certified with a seal and the signature of an authorised person. No later than three working days after presentation of the award, the record is submitted to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow, and a certified copy to the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “The record is signed by the person who presented the awards and…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 32. If errors are discovered in decrees or executive orders of the Mayor of Moscow granting awards (incorrect surname, first name, patronymic or job title), a statement amending the recipient’s surname (first name, patronymic or position) is drawn up and signed by the official who presented the award.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “32. If errors are discovered in decrees or executive orders of…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: The petition to correct the Mayor of Moscow’s award decree or executive order and the statement are submitted with the award presentation record to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “The petition to correct the Mayor of Moscow’s award decree or…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 33. If an award cannot be presented because the recipient has changed workplace or residence or the recipient’s employment has ended, the head of the personnel unit entrusted with organising the presentation sends a notification and returns the unpresented award and its document to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow, which takes steps to organise its presentation.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “33. If an award cannot be presented because the recipient has…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: If a recipient cannot attend the award ceremony for health reasons, the award may, with the recipient’s consent, be presented at home or in a medical institution.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “If a recipient cannot attend the award ceremony for health…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: <*> The procedure for recording and storing awards of the City of Moscow in the Awards Section of the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow is established in accordance with the Instructions on the Procedure for Recording and Storing Orders, Medals, Distinctions, Breast Badges for Honorary Titles of the Russian Federation and Blank Documents Relating to Them, approved by Executive Order of the President of the Russian Federation of 14.10.1997 No. 417-рп.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “<*> The procedure for recording and storing awards of the City…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 4. Procedure for transferring deceased recipients’ awards to their heirs
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “4. Procedure for transferring deceased recipients’ awards to…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 34. Deceased recipients’ awards and the associated documents are transferred to their heirs—spouse (husband, wife), children (son, daughter), parents (father, mother)—for safekeeping as mementoes, without the right to wear the awards. 35. The awards and associated documents of deceased recipients are transferred in the order in which the heirs are listed. Disputes between heirs are resolved by them through judicial proceedings.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “34. Deceased recipients’ awards and the associated documents…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 36. The Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow organises the transfer of awards to the heirs of deceased recipients.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “36. The Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 37. Officials who transfer an award and its document to a recipient’s heir must submit a record of that transfer to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow no later than 5 days after the transfer.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “37. Officials who transfer an award and its document to a…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 38. If a recipient has no heirs, the awards and their documents must be returned to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “38. If a recipient has no heirs, the awards and their documents…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 5. Procedure for initiating petitions for duplicates of lost awards and their documents
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “5. Procedure for initiating petitions for duplicates of lost…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 39. If awards and their documents are lost in combat, as a result of a natural disaster or in other circumstances in which their loss could not be prevented, recipients may be issued duplicates of the awards by decision of the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “39. If awards and their documents are lost in combat, as a…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: Duplicates of the Certificate of Honour of the Government of Moscow, the diploma for a Prize of the City of Moscow and the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow are not issued. If they are lost, the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow may issue recipients with certificates confirming the award of the Certificate of Honour, the granting of the prize or the declaration of the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “Duplicates of the Certificate of Honour of the Government of…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 40. Recipients report the loss of awards in applications to the head of the organisation at their place of work; those not employed apply to local self-government bodies at their place of residence.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “40. Recipients report the loss of awards in applications to the…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: Recipients who have lost awards on the grounds specified in paragraph 39 of these Instructions may petition the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow for duplicates.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “Recipients who have lost awards on the grounds specified in…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: In addition to the request for a duplicate award, the application states the recipient’s position, surname, first name, patronymic and year of birth, and describes the circumstances of the loss. It is accompanied by documents confirming the award (copies of award certificates or an archival certificate confirming the award), a certificate from the relevant state body or institution confirming the circumstances of the loss, and a character reference from the recipient’s most recent place of work or, for a person not employed, from the place of residence.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “In addition to the request for a duplicate award, the…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 41. If awards are stolen, the recipient reports the theft to the internal affairs bodies. A petition for duplicates is initiated after one year has elapsed from the date those bodies were notified of the theft. In addition to the documents specified in paragraph 40 of these Instructions, the application must include a certificate from the internal affairs body concerning the recipient’s report of the theft and the results of the search for the awards.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “41. If awards are stolen, the recipient reports the theft to…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 42. The Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow considers applications for duplicate awards received and forwards them to the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow, which takes the appropriate decision.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “42. The Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 43. The Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow issues duplicate awards to recipients on the basis of a decision of the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “43. The Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: The letter ‘д’ (duplicate) is reproduced on the reverse of duplicate awards.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “The letter ‘д’ (duplicate) is reproduced on the reverse of…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 44. Petitions for duplicates of lost award documents are initiated under the procedure established for duplicate awards (paragraphs 39–43 of these Instructions). A character reference for the person who lost the award document is not required.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “44. Petitions for duplicates of lost award documents are…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 45. In cases other than those specified in paragraph 39 of these Instructions, the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow issues certificates confirming the award instead of duplicate award documents.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “45. In cases other than those specified in paragraph 39 of…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 6. Wearing awards
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “6. Wearing awards”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 46. Where a recipient has state awards of the Russian Federation and the USSR, awards of the City of Moscow are placed after or below the state awards of the Russian Federation.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “46. Where a recipient has state awards of the Russian…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 47. Distinctions, the honorary badges ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’, ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’ and ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’, the breast badge ‘Laureate of the Prize of the City of Moscow’, the breast badge for the Certificate of Honour of the Government of Moscow and breast badges for honorary titles are worn on the right side of the chest.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “47. Distinctions, the honorary badges ‘Honoured Teacher of the…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: Where there are several awards and honorary titles, they are arranged from left to right in the following order: the distinctions ‘For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow’ for L, XL, XXX, XXV and XX years; the honorary badges ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’, ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’ and ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’; the breast badge ‘Laureate of the Prize of the City of Moscow’; the breast badge for the Certificate of Honour of the Government of Moscow; and the breast badge for an honorary title.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “Where there are several awards and honorary titles, they are…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: Recipients of awards and honorary titles may wear the distinctions, honorary badges, breast badges, their miniature copies or their lapel badges.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “Recipients of awards and honorary titles may wear the…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: The award nomination form is prepared on a sheet of A3 paper using a computer or typewriter.
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “The award nomination form is prepared on a sheet of A3 paper…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: No shortened forms, abbreviations, inaccuracies or corrections are permitted when completing the award nomination form.
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “No shortened forms, abbreviations, inaccuracies or corrections…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: The following information is entered in the appropriate items of the award nomination form:
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “The following information is entered in the appropriate items…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: - the name of the administrative district and district of the City of Moscow in whose territory the nominating organisation is located according to the legal entity’s address entered in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities;
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “- the name of the administrative district and district of the…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: - the name of the award or honorary title in accordance with Law of the City of Moscow of 05.09.2001 No. 38 ‘On Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow’;
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “- the name of the award or honorary title in accordance with…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: - the nominee’s surname, first name and patronymic (in the nominative case), date of birth (day, month, year) and place of birth, as stated in the passport or other identity document;
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “- the nominee’s surname, first name and patronymic (in the…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: - the nominee’s position and place of work, as recorded in the employment record book (service contract or other documents confirming the performance of official duties in the position held) or duly certified employment history information, including the full name of the organisation, state authority or local self-government body (in the genitive case) in accordance with documents confirming the information entered in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities;
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “- the nominee’s position and place of work, as recorded in the…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: - the nominee’s education and speciality as stated in the diploma (including the full name of the educational organisation and year of graduation);
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “- the nominee’s education and speciality as stated in the…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: - the nominee’s academic degree, academic title and titles awarded by state academies of sciences;
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “- the nominee’s academic degree, academic title and titles…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: - the nominee’s state awards, including state awards of the Russian Federation, the USSR and the RSFSR, with the year of award, in the following order: Russian Federation awards in chronological order, USSR awards in order of precedence (where there are several), and RSFSR awards;
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “- the nominee’s state awards, including state awards of the…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: - awards and honorary titles of the City of Moscow, awards of federal executive authorities and other incentives are listed in chronological order;
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “- awards and honorary titles of the City of Moscow, awards of…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: - the nominee’s home address as stated in the passport or, if the identity document contains no place-of-residence information, in accordance with another document confirming residence, as well as the nominee’s contact telephone number and individual personal account insurance number;
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “- the nominee’s home address as stated in the passport or, if…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: - employment and service history (including study at vocational educational organisations and higher education organisations, military and other service), in accordance with entries in the employment record book or duly certified employment history information, education diplomas, the military service document and other documents confirming the nominee’s employment (performance of official duties). Study is listed only where it was full-time. Secondary employment is listed after the principal employment history;
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “- employment and service history (including study at vocational…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: - a character reference specifying the nominee’s particular merits over the last 5 years (over the last 10–15 years when petitioning for an honorary title of the City of Moscow), enabling an objective assessment of the nominee’s contribution to addressing the tasks of the City of Moscow’s socioeconomic, political and cultural development.
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “- a character reference specifying the nominee’s particular…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: The character reference describes the nominee’s personal achievements in work and service, qualifications, effectiveness and quality of work, and participation in public activities. A life history, service record or list of job duties is not permitted.
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “The character reference describes the nominee’s personal…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: The character reference may continue on an additional separate sheet inserted in the award nomination form (no more than one page), signed by the head of the organisation, state authority or local self-government body and certified with a seal.
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “The character reference may continue on an additional separate…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: The award nomination form is signed by the head of the organisation, state authority or local self-government body and the chair (head) of the primary trade union organisation (if any), and certified with a seal.
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “The award nomination form is signed by the head of the…”

units.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
units.text: The award nomination form is endorsed by the head of the relevant executive authority of the City of Moscow and the Deputy Mayor of Moscow in the Government of Moscow who supervises and coordinates that authority’s work. The endorsing persons’ signatures are certified with a seal.
units.label: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS · “The award nomination form is endorsed by the head of the…”
